name: 91320 · Newbury Park, CA
findings: ZIP 91320 (Newbury Park) has 164 nonprofit organizations. 70 of them (43%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 55 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (29% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 91320 (Newbury Park) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Few social and fraternal organizations list membership
observations.text: No social and fraternal organizations here list membership. In similar places of this size, about 6 would.
